title: Lake Garda
description: Analogue photographs from Lake Garda by Bart Mulder: boats, a ferry and the rocky lakeshore below green mountains, all shot on film.

images.alt: A boat floating on the water in an open sea under a partly cloudy sky.
Empty ferry interior with brown chairs, tables, and a vending machine, windows showing water outside, and various safety signs on the blue striped walls.
A coin-operated viewing binoculars on a lakeside promenade with mountains and buildings in the background.
A small white boat floating on calm water, viewed from under overhanging pine tree branches, with distant islands under a partly cloudy sky.
People relaxing on a rocky lakeshore with umbrellas, mountains in the background, and a partly cloudy sky.
Scenic view of a winding river surrounded by green mountains under a partly cloudy sky, framed by tree foliage in the foreground.

Sunlit rustic wooden interior with a window featuring a decorative iron grill, overlooking a mountainous landscape, a hanging light fixture, a table with a cloth, a potted plant, and a sofa with pillows.
